workload: isolated synthetic local WAV playback, volume 0, six queued copies of one six-minute fixture; 20,000 seeded metadata-only fixture listings; MCP library search pages during playback

measurement.limitations: Application group excludes the separately sampled Vite server. When shared, Vite CPU/RSS/I/O can include unrelated clients and activity and is not attributable only to this app. Each process-group RSS sums resident pages and can double-count shared memory; storage IO is not network traffic; short-lived children between polls may be missed.

limitations: Synthetic local audio and synthetic metadata only; no provider login or network playback was used.
This measures the isolated app and observed descendants on this Linux host, not cross-platform performance.
Profiler RSS aggregates process RSS and may double-count shared pages; storage IO is not network traffic.
Vite is sampled as a separate sibling process group; its CPU/RSS/I/O are excluded from application totals.
The 30-second playback settle time is excluded from the profiler window; build/compilation is not run by this script.
